Before we begin

A few things
you may wonder.

What kind of events can I enquire about?

Private celebrations, social gatherings, launches and brand events. Send the location, schedule, approximate guest count and what you need the photographs for.

Can we use the photographs for business and social media?

Let me know the intended channels and use before booking. The proposal will specify the agreed usage and any additional licensing requirements.

Can you cover an evening event?

Yes, evening photography is part of my portfolio. We’ll discuss the venue lighting, programme and any restrictions on flash or equipment beforehand.

How quickly can we receive the images?

Share your deadline when you enquire. The delivery schedule and any priority selection are agreed before booking; urgent delivery is subject to availability.

Planning your session

A little preparation.

What to include in an event photography brief

A clear brief helps an event photographer understand what the images need to do after the event. Start with the audience and intended use, then identify the moments, people and deadlines that matter.
